blurb: In 1960, Raymond Ristau, his brother, Elwyn, and their father, Albert, envisioned a golf course gracing their picturesque property on Jackson Run Rd. They enlisted C.E. “Robbie” Robinson, then President of the Canadian Golf Association, to design the initial nine holes.
